formula.expression: long_leg = streak_sign_m == +1 and SURP_quintile_m == 5; short_leg = streak_sign_m == -1 and SURP_quintile_m == 1
formula.paper_expression: Buy positive streaks in highest SURP quintile; sell negative streaks in lowest SURP quintile
calculation_steps: Classify SURP sign as positive if SURP_q > 0 and negative if SURP_q <= 0.
Identify positive and negative streaks of at least two consecutive same-signed quarterly SURPs.
Each month, sort stocks into quintiles based on the magnitude of their most recent SURP.
Assign SURP_quintile = 5 to the largest SURP quintile and SURP_quintile = 1 to the smallest SURP quintile.
Buy stocks with positive streaks in SURP quintile 5 and sell stocks with negative streaks in SURP quintile 1; exclude lagged price below five dollars and hold for six months.

source.interpretation: The table caption states monthly SURP sign/quintile sorts, streak/reversal separation, six-month holdings, and the below-five-dollar exclusion.

sign.meaning: The long leg is positive streaks in the largest SURP quintile; the short leg is negative streaks in the smallest SURP quintile.
